milad.prompt:
Use case: compositing / architectural background variation.
Input image 1 is the room and material reference. Create ONE clean background plate for MILAD's camera in this same reading room, not a collage or split screen. Landscape 16:9, preferably 2560x1440 or highest available resolution.
Retain the same grey textured plaster, dark walnut joinery, muted books, handmade ceramics, subtle greenery, natural left-window daylight, restrained warm practical light and realistic lived-in contemporary Persian literary atmosphere. Match the reference exposure and colour balance, with gently soft background depth for a seated talking-head recording.
Camera A: eye-level, closer, angled slightly toward the LEFT end of the referenced room. A slim section of the tall daylight window at the far left, walnut shelving with a few books and the dark ceramic vessel in the left third, textured grey plaster extending across the middle and right. A small framed artwork off to the far right if visible. Use attractive soft diagonal daylight and foliage shadows across the wall. The centre 50 percent should have calm midtone texture behind a future head and shoulders; no strong vertical edge or lamp directly behind a head. Background begins several metres behind the future speaker. Almost no floor visible, as this is a camera background rather than a room real-estate photograph.
Preserve a coherent plausible room, not an exact crop or mirrored duplicate. No people, bodies, silhouettes, foreground chairs, desk, microphones, text, logos, overlays, panels or borders. No new decorative motifs, flags or national symbols. Leave people, placement, captions and compositing to the video editor. Background only.

hooman.prompt:

Detail concentrated at edges; centre 50 percent calm textured midtones with no strong vertical line or lamp behind a future face. Background several metres behind a future seated talking head, medium depth of field with gently softened small details, almost no floor in view.
